task_title: Promote validated merge-train prefixes before later build failure

plan_review.notes: Adopted cumulative-candidate semantics: the highest successful built prefix proves every PR through that index even when intermediate prefixes are missing or pending. Added the canonical missing,success case; clarified that later built-but-unvalidated candidates are excluded. Kept a focused helper because normal maximal-first planning would choose a later missing candidate instead of rescuing an earlier success after a build failure.
